cargo-audit_missing: cargo-audit is not in the JGates tools image ({detail}). Download the tools of this JGates version (jgates setup); JGates never installs a tool on your machine.
cargo-audit_probe_failed: cargo-audit at {path} did not answer its version query.
cargo-audit_no_lockfile: No Cargo.lock was found in the scan root, so there is nothing to audit. Run cargo generate-lockfile and commit the lock file.
cargo-audit_exit_error: cargo-audit ended with code {code} without a valid report: {detail}
cargo-audit_timeout: cargo-audit exceeded the limit of {seconds} s and was ended.
cargo-audit_cancelled: The run was cancelled; cargo-audit was stopped and its partial output was kept in the logs.
cargo-audit_invalid_output: The cargo-audit output is not the expected audit JSON: {detail}
cargo-audit_no_invocation: The plan has no cargo-audit invocation for the instance {tool}.
cargo-audit_reason_completed: cargo-audit {version}: {count, plural, one {# advisory finding} other {# advisory findings}} in {packages, plural, one {# locked package} other {# locked packages}}
cargo-audit_warnings: {count} of them are non-blocking warnings (unmaintained, unsound or yanked)
cargo-audit_limitation_matching: Advisories are matched on the locked package versions, not on the call graph; the ignore list of .cargo/audit.toml is a scanner exception, not a waiver of the gate.
cargo-audit_condition_network: Offline: the RustSec advisory database comes from the jgates-data volume (read-only, no network, --no-fetch). Without it the check is incomplete (DATA_MISSING); older than the limit (default 7 days) it is DATA_STALE.
